Wants and needs

What you want, not what you will tolerate. Each one changes the arithmetic: where it can be bought, the price goes on the bill; where it cannot, the flight is charged for lacking it and sinks, with the reason shown. The number is how many of these flights already have it.

    How the grade works

    Every flight is priced the same way: the ticket, the bag you carry, the ride from your door and to theirs at that hour, your time at a rate, and small charges for what makes a trip worse. One number, in dollars, with every line shown. The letter never moves. The order is yours.
